opening.opening_summary: A heavy-economy, heavy-production, heavy-technology Terran opening that prioritizes macro development and tech progression while keeping ground forces as the core. The opening is flexible, allowing adaptation to Protoss air or ground compositions based on scouting.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a technology / economy / production posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
